obstruction: The parser preserves theorem declarations only as Unsupported, so an invalid theorem whose type is Sort 0 returns UNKNOWN instead of REJECT.
least_candidate_capability: Represent theorem declarations explicitly, require their declared type to infer as Prop (Sort 0), check the proof before authority extension, and retain theorem opacity during delta.
strongest_competing_explanation: Treat the theorem as an ordinary definition; this loses the theorem-specific proposition obligation and could accept non-propositional proof objects.
falsifier: Reject if exact case 012 is not rejected, a qualified theorem fails, theorem self-reference is accepted, or theorem bodies become conversion fuel.
causal_ablation: Unsupported theorem returns UNKNOWN; explicit theorem validation must return REJECT on the identical fixture.

performance_plan.promotion_rule: same-identity candidate and flash counters only
